Hi Sarah / team —

Attached is Draft v1 of the agenda and a short pre-read checklist. Highlights below and a couple of prep asks.

Agenda (90 minutes):
- 14:00–14:10 (10m) Welcome, introductions, success criteria (Dev + Sarah)
- 14:10–14:40 (30m) Prompt deep-dive: review your sample prompts, identify routing & system message opportunities (Marissa lead)
- 14:40–15:05 (25m) Routing & fallback demo: multi-variant routing, model variants, and KV cache warmup (Aditya lead)
- 15:05–15:25 (20m) Load test: small-scale burst (2–5 RPS) to validate throughput + tracing hooks (Aditya lead)
- 15:25–15:30 (5m) Confirm next steps & action owners

Prep / pre-read (please complete before the session):
- Upload 5–10 representative prompts and one sample payload file to the shared Drive folder (put in /acme/payloads).
- Flag any sensitive fields — we will redact or use synthetic values.
- Let us know if you prefer Redwood to run the load test (we’ll use constrained runners) or if Omar wants to run it locally with our script.

Attachments included: [Attachment: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf], [Attachment: pre-read-checklist.md]

Quick notes on load testing:
- We will simulate realistic token counts (avg 350 tokens per request) and an initial cache-warmup sweep.
- Expected minimal infra footprint for this test; we will cap concurrency to avoid impacting your staging environment.

Marissa Cole
Product Solutions
Redwood Inference
